planning_notes: The original requirement states: every 1 second toggle two LEDs connected to D12 and D13. Electrical wiring is only these two digital outputs; no other pins are specified.
Start-up LED states are not specified in the prose; both outputs are set to initial=false. Any desired initial phase (which LED starts ON first) must be handled in the SysML model.
A time-dependent behavior is required; an elapsed_ms input is requested and is intended for the model to accumulate to 1000ms and then toggle LED states.
No serial I/O is requested/required by the provided inventory; therefore serial_channels is empty.

interfaces.name: io_0
interfaces.meaning: LED state for LED connected to D12 (toggles every 1s)

interfaces.name: io_1
interfaces.meaning: LED state for LED connected to D13 (toggles every 1s)

interfaces.name: io_2
interfaces.meaning: Actual delta since previous control step
